description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5998015686978 PRINTED CIRCUIT BOA: Line 0001 Qty 24 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0147 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
